players.product: neutral-atom quantum processors (200-qubit QPU hosted at Aramco's Dhahran data center)

quarterly_data.signal: Pasqal 6-K (business combination closing release): Pasqal had approximately $360 million of cash available at closing and intends to deploy it on expanding the manufacturing and deployment of its QPUs, advancing its roadmap toward fault-tolerant quantum computing, broadening access to its cloud and software platform, deepening integration with classical HPC infrastructure and scaling commercial operations globally; its QPU fleet supports more than 25 commercial and research applications. CEO Wasiq Bokhari: 'Our systems operate in standard data center environments and are built to scale with enterprise workloads.'
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $360 million cash available at closing; more than 25 applications
